clue.text: Make a detour to find ring buried in the earth

indicators.note: something buried in the earth sits inside it, so the ring letter goes within the word for earth

parts.note: the earth underfoot is the ground
a ring is round, the shape of the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone takes a long way round to locate a ring lost in the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buried in' puts O inside GROUND, just after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To go round something is to take an indirect route, which is what a detour is.

clue.text: Elderly relation meets transatlantic lawman in Spain

parts.note: a gran is a grandmother
transatlantic, seen from Britain, means American, abbreviated A
a DA is a district attorney, the American public prosecutor

explanation.surface: Grandma bumps into an American lawyer in Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transatlantic lawman' gives A (American) plus DA (district attorney).
explanation.definitionFit: Granada is a city of Andalusia, home of the Alhambra, so it lies within that country.

clue.text: A leper's treatment clearly hasn't worked!

indicators.note: a treatment works things over, so the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: A patient with leprosy is plainly not responding to the cure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment' rearranges A LEPERS; the whole clue tells of a cure failing.
explanation.definitionFit: A relapse is a fall back into illness after seeming recovery, a sign the cure has failed.

clue.text: Extreme device for decoding Enigma variations

definitions.meaning: the Allied codename for intelligence obtained by breaking German Enigma ciphers

explanation.definitionFit: Ultra- as a prefix means beyond; in the war it named the Bletchley Park intelligence from cracking Enigma.

clue.text: Pocket pistol for the German campanologist

parts.note: der is the German word for the (masculine)
a campanologist is a bell-ringer

explanation.surface: A small handgun is meant for a bell-ringer from Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: A derringer is a small short-barrelled handgun, easily hidden in a pocket.

clue.text: Church curator makes Salvation Army get Catholic backing first

indicators.note: the abbreviation for Catholic is turned backwards, as if it were backing up

parts.note: RC stands for Roman Catholic
first is written 1ST, and the figure 1 stands in for the letter I

explanation.surface: A church official teams the Salvation Army with Catholic support from the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns RC into CR; 1ST for 'first' gives IST, the 1 read as I.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacrist is the sexton or sacristan who looks after a church's vessels and vestments.

clue.text: Made notes about Latin colloquialisms

indicators.note: the word for made notes goes about, around, the abbreviation

parts.note: to make musical notes with the voice is to sing, past tense sang

explanation.surface: Someone jotted down Latin expressions of everyday speech.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Made notes' is musical, not writing. 'about' puts L inside SANG.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang is informal vocabulary, the words of casual conversation.

clue.text: Record very serious article in French

parts.note: chronic in British informal use means very bad or serious
le is a French definite article

explanation.surface: Someone writes up a grave piece in French.
explanation.definitionFit: A chronicle is a historical account of events in order, a record.

clue.text: What an artist may produce one minute past midnight

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
midnight is zero hour, 00:00, and the zero stands as the letter O

explanation.surface: A painter is at work just after twelve at night.
explanation.walkthrough: Midnight on a 24-hour clock is 00:00, so it supplies the 0 read as O.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is paint laid on thickly so that brush or knife marks stand out, a technique a painter creates.

clue.text: Lets us cook up small scraps

indicators.note: to cook something up is to concoct it, so these letters are mixed into a new order

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: A cook agrees to whip up little leftovers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cook up' rearranges LETSUS, then S goes on the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A tussle is a scuffle or fight, and a scrap is the same thing in slang.

clue.text: Nothing but pitch counts for an outstanding cast

parts.note: nothing but pitch means all of it is pitch
counts in the sense 'is', abbreviated to 'S
pitch is the black sticky substance tar

explanation.surface: Only the pitch matters, says someone casting a show with stars.
explanation.walkthrough: The wordplay reads as ALL'S TAR, 'all is pitch'.
explanation.definitionFit: An all-star line-up is one made up entirely of celebrated performers, a cast of outstanding names.

clue.text: A professional position would be suitable

parts.note: a pro is a professional
POS is a common abbreviation for position

explanation.surface: Someone muses that a job for a professional would be fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos means pertinent or fitting to the matter in hand, hence suitable.

clue.text: A very quiet London borough is attractive

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
Ealing is a borough in west London

explanation.surface: A peaceful London suburb holds great charm.
explanation.walkthrough: EALING is a borough of west London.
explanation.definitionFit: Something appealing draws you in, which is to say it is attractive.

clue.text: Rhino needs sodium salt

parts.note: Na is the chemical symbol for sodium
sal is the Latin and pharmacists' word for salt, as in sal volatile

explanation.surface: A rhinoceros needs a salt lick to supply its sodium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rhino' is not the animal but the Greek prefix for nose, as in rhinoplasty.
explanation.definitionFit: The combining form rhino- refers to the nose, and nasal means of the nose.

clue.text: Skilled enough for a small government ministry

parts.note: a ministry is a government department, shortened to DEPT

explanation.surface: Someone is competent enough to work in a minor government office.
explanation.definitionFit: An adept person is expert, highly proficient at something.

clue.text: Argue the point to bring the children along

definitions.meaning: to dispute or disagree with something
issue means offspring, so to bring your children is to take them

explanation.definitionFit: To dispute something is to take issue with it; issue also means offspring, so it is to take one's kids.

clue.text: Make one's point, but be marked wrong

definitions.meaning: receive an X on one's work, the mark for an error

explanation.definitionFit: To get something across is to make it understood; to receive a cross on homework is to be marked as incorrect.

clue.text: Its job — to compel the Argentines to surrender!

definitions.text: Its job — to compel the Argentines to surrender!

parts.note: a task is a job
to force someone is to compel them

explanation.surface: The mission of the British fleet was making Argentina give in.
explanation.walkthrough: The Falklands task force sailed in 1982 to make Argentina give up the islands.
explanation.definitionFit: A task force is a military unit formed for one mission, as Britain sent to the Falklands.

clue.text: Call to ban women's wear from the suburbs

parts.note: a shout of 'Out!' calls for something to be banished
skirts are garments worn by women

explanation.surface: Campaigners demand a ban on skirts in the suburbs.
explanation.definitionFit: The outskirts are the outer districts of a town, where the suburbs lie.

clue.text: Where one expects to find fruit or vegetable

definitions.text: Where one expects to find fruit

parts.note: chard is a leafy green vegetable

explanation.surface: A grocer wonders where to find produce, fruit or vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Fruit trees are grown together in an orchard.

clue.text: Third-rate angels are supporters of kings

definitions.meaning: in the traditional hierarchy of angels, the third order
royal seats, which hold up kings

explanation.definitionFit: Thrones rank third among the nine choirs of angels; a monarch sits on a throne.

clue.text: Former Irishman now living abroad

parts.note: ex- means former
Pat, short for Patrick, is the stock crossword Irishman

explanation.surface: A one-time Irishman has emigrated.
explanation.definitionFit: An expatriate is someone who lives outside their native country.

clue.text: Basket for girl in marine promenade

indicators.note: the girl's name is set inside the promenade word

parts.note: a pier is a walkway built out over the sea
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A basket is meant for a young woman strolling by the sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'marine promenade' is the seaside walkway jutting out over the water; the 'in' tells where the girl's name goes.
explanation.definitionFit: A pannier is a basket, especially one of a pair slung across a bike or a pack animal.

clue.text: Where scenes are created by article on rate review

indicators.note: in a down clue the article sits on top, so it comes first

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: a review looks things over again, so these letters are reworked into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Scenes are made by a write-up about a tariff review.
explanation.walkthrough: 'review' rearranges RATE to ATRE, which goes under THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Scenes of plays are staged in a theatre.

clue.text: One going after fish bones

indicators.note: one piece comes after the other, so the numeral follows the fish

parts.note: the carp is a freshwater fish
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone goes in search of fish bones.
explanation.definitionFit: The carpi are the small bones of the wrist, the plural of carpus.

clue.text: In military resistance sappers gain respect

indicators.note: the word for resistance gains extra letters, taking them inside itself

parts.note: defence is military resistance to attack
sappers are the Royal Engineers, abbreviated RE

explanation.surface: Army engineers win respect for their part in holding the line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gain' signals insertion: the resistance word takes in the engineers. Sappers are soldiers of the Royal Engineers, who dig and build in the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Deference is courteous submission, the regard shown to someone you esteem.

clue.text: Bill gets a call-up in America

definitions.meaning: a bill of exchange, a written order to pay money
US term for conscription into the armed forces

explanation.definitionFit: A draft is a written order for payment such as a bill; in the US it also means conscription.

clue.text: Push back piano in middle of Scottish dance

indicators.note: the piano letter is put into the centre of the dance word

parts.note: the reel is a lively Scottish dance
p is the musical marking for piano, softly

explanation.surface: Someone shoves a piano aside in the midst of a ceilidh dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in middle of' puts P between the two Es of REEL.
explanation.definitionFit: To repel is to drive back or ward off.

clue.text: Forgetting a name is bizarre

indicators.note: something bizarre is strange and out of order, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: It is odd to blank on someone's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnesia is loss of memory, a condition of being unable to recall things.

clue.text: Heavy fabric isn't used to refurbish an old coat

parts.note: rep is a heavy corded fabric used for upholstery
ain't is the colloquial form of isn't

explanation.surface: A thick cloth is not used to restore a worn jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coat' means a layer of paint, not a garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To renew an old layer of paint you apply fresh paint over it.

clue.text: Maybe a group of devil worshippers chop up bodies

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, a name for the devil
a sect is a group of worshippers

explanation.surface: Satanists suspected of cutting up corpses.
explanation.walkthrough: Dis is the underworld ruler, so 'devil' gives DIS; a sect is a body of worshippers.
explanation.definitionFit: Anatomists dissect bodies, cutting them apart to study their structure.

clue.text: General disposition to blow things up

indicators.note: a disposition is an arrangement, so the letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A general's arrangement of forces for blowing things up.
explanation.definitionFit: To blow up a photograph is to make it bigger.
